githubOidc.source: GitHub Actions OIDC request environment or --github-oidc-token

positiveAssertions: CLI validates the tenant app enrollment unless --skip-validate is supplied
CLI submits source-unknown workflow evidence through PublicAPI using a GitHub OIDC bearer token
evidence payload includes operation ID, one-time nonce, config hash, artifact digest, and image digest
evidence payload includes repository/ref/commit/workflow OIDC claim metadata
server-side validation consumes the setup operation and blocks replay
negativeAssertions: empty app key is rejected before evidence submission
missing operation ID or nonce is rejected before PublicAPI mutation
artifact and image digests must be sha256:<64 hex chars>
wrong tenant enrollment validation prevents evidence submission
live smoke does not consume nonce state by default
